title: REQ · Runtime validators return typed data or path-named errors without throwing
summary: parseManifest and parseAsset validator functions with a public index
description: Context: schemas alone throw on failure. Desired behavior: validator functions return a discriminated result with typed data or an error list naming field paths, plus duplicate asset id detection, exported via index.ts. Expected result: callers can validate untrusted manifest JSON safely. Why: handle bad content gracefully.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid manifest, when parseManifest runs, then ok is true and data is typed
Given an invalid manifest, when parseManifest runs, then ok is false and errors contain the failing field path
Given two assets with the same id, when parseManifest runs, then ok is false and an error names the duplicate id
Given non-object input, when parseManifest runs, then it returns ok false without throwing
